title: Identification of Genetic Factors Implicated in Orofacial Cleft Using Whole Exome Sequencing
brief_summary: Despite significant progress made in identification on numerous genes and gene pathways critical for craniofacial development, several approaches, ie mutation screening of specific candidates, association studies and even genome-wide scans have largely failed to reveal the molecular basis of NS human clefting
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subject with a NSCL/P or CL/P of unknown etiology,
* national health care insurance holders

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subject with a CL/P of known etiology,
* Subject with a NSCL/P and an IRF6 mutation
